cohort: 150 patients ready for discharge from the obstetrics ward at King Abdulaziz University Hospital
finding: Several factors were found to affect patient satisfaction in the obstetrics and gynaecology department, including demographic characteristics, mode of admission, mode of delivery, type of anaesthesia, and length of hospital stay.
mod_finding: Patient satisfaction was higher among women who delivered vaginally compared to those who had a caesarean section.
